scope: All 276 tracked dashboard audit files plus the two untracked startup-review files; report artifacts excluded from their own inventory. All audit blob versions reachable in HEAD history.
method: Full file contents, raw and JSON-decoded strings, compared with the local portfolio blocklist and local account names. Additional email, home-path, IBAN and private-key pattern checks. Matches retain counts only; private source values are omitted.
fixture_review: The only ISIN-like literals occur in 2026-10-30-react-2/evidence/fixture-review.json. FR0000000000, FR0000000001 and the Apple holding identifier originate in tracked source test fixtures; no local portfolio token matches. PEA/CTO are generic synthetic account labels.
limits: Local-data-derived matching is not a general DLP guarantee. Standalone financial amounts, unknown personal identifiers, images and other encodings are not exhaustively detected. Ignored raw audit evidence is excluded; force-adding it still triggers the hooks. Home-path protection uses the current local home directory. The two affected local branches were rewritten; a private recovery archive is retained outside the repository. Historical entries identify sanitized objects.

history_remediation.verification: All historical audit blobs in the recorded baseline rescanned after sanitization; current application tree preserved. Author, committer, timestamps and messages preserved.
